medica.heading: Less switching. More context.
medica.subheading: MEDIKA brings the stages of a consultation together so the clinical team can work from the same patient context.
medica.demoNote: The public demo uses fictional, sanitized records. Explore it without entering real patient information.
medica.problem: Patient information and day-to-day practice tasks need to stay connected, from the waiting room to the consultation record.
medica.solution: A single workspace for patient records, clinical history, diagnoses, prescriptions and documents, with separate doctor and secretary workflows.
medica.engineering: Connected workflows, structured records and role-based interfaces make MEDIKA a concrete example of how AKDEVIA approaches business software.
medica.screenshots: Screenshots from the public demo. All patient records shown are fictional.
